description: This file defines the ParserInputMethodManagerService class, a specialized parser for input method manager service trace files in a trace analysis tool. It includes methods for decoding trace data, extracting timestamps, and processing trace entries.

classes.name: ParserInputMethodManagerService
classes.description: A parser class for input method manager service trace files, extending AbstractParser to decode and process trace entries.

methods.name: getTraceType
methods.description: Returns the trace type enumeration for input method manager service traces.

methods.name: getMagicNumber
methods.description: Returns the magic number signature identifying this trace file type.

methods.name: decodeTrace
methods.description: Decodes a buffer into trace entries and updates the time offset if present.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Generates a Timestamp object based on the trace entry and requested timestamp type.

methods.name: processDecodedEntry
methods.description: Processes a decoded trace entry, computes timing information, and formats the trace node.
